title: All users may join devices to Entra ID

messages.businessImpact: Any user can bring a machine under the organisation's identity, which is how unmanaged and unpatched devices end up holding company data.
remediation: Under Entra device settings, change Users may join devices to Selected and name the group that provisions machines, rather than leaving it at All.
Put the people who actually build devices in that group. User-driven Autopilot still works for them, and nobody else can bring a machine under the organisation's identity.
None blocks Entra join outright, which breaks Autopilot, so a subset is the setting to aim at rather than the other extreme.
messages.cannotSee: Who may join is read from the directory's own device registration policy. Whether the people it names should be allowed to join is a judgement this cannot make; what it reports is that the tenant has not narrowed it at all.
